import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'brand': ['Leica', 'Fuji', 'Pentax', 'Olympus', 'Leica'],
    'model_year': [2005, 2019, 2012, 2015, 2016],
    'megapixels': [13.5, 46.4, 38.7, 22.5, 12.2],
    'max_iso': [25600, 51200, 12800, 6400, 25600],
    'weight_grams': [324, 1151, 598, 1095, 290],
    'price_usd': [811.8, 3596.41, 3357.2, 1555.7, 3899.09],
    'sensor_type': ['Micro 4/3', 'APS-C', 'Full Frame', 'APS-C', 'Medium Format'],
    'has_video_4k': [1, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'lens_mount': ['E', 'EF', 'MFT', 'Z', 'MFT'],
    'body_type': ['Compact', 'Mirrorless', 'Mirrorless', 'Mirrorless', 'DSLR']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16))

# 1. Scatter plot: Price vs Megapixels with sensor type coloring
ax1 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 1)
scatter = ax1.scatter(df['megapixels'], df['price_usd'], 
                      c=df['model_year'], s=df['weight_grams']/10, 
                      alpha=0.7, cmap='viridis', edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels')
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)')
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels (size=weight, color=year)')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax1, label='Model Year')

# Add brand labels
for i, row in df.iterrows():
    ax1.annotate(row['brand'], (row['megapixels'], row['price_usd']), 
                xytext=(5, 5), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=9)

# 2. Bar plot: Average price by brand
ax2 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 2)
price_by_brand = df.groupby('brand')['price_usd'].mean().sort_values()
bars = ax2.bar(price_by_brand.index, price_by_brand.values)
ax2.set_xlabel('Brand')
ax2.set_ylabel('Average Price (USD)')
ax2.set_title('Average Price by Brand')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Add value labels on bars
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax2.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 50,
             f'${height:.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 3. Bar plot: Camera count by body type
ax3 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 3)
body_type_counts = df['body_type'].value_counts()
bars3 = ax3.bar(body_type_counts.index, body_type_counts.values)
ax3.set_xlabel('Body Type')
ax3.set_ylabel('Count')
ax3.set_title('Camera Distribution by Body Type')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

for bar in bars3:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.1,
             str(int(height)), ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 4. Line plot: Technology progression over years
ax4 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 4)
df_sorted = df.sort_values('model_year')
ax4.plot(df_sorted['model_year'], df_sorted['megapixels'], marker='o', label='Megapixels', linewidth=2)
ax4.plot(df_sorted['model_year'], df_sorted['max_iso']/1000, marker='s', label='Max ISO (x1000)', linewidth=2)
ax4.set_xlabel('Model Year')
ax4.set_ylabel('Value')
ax4.set_title('Technology Progression Over Years')
ax4.legend()
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 5. Box plot: Price distribution by sensor type
ax5 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 5)
sensor_order = df.groupby('sensor_type')['price_usd'].median().sort_values().index
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='sensor_type', y='price_usd', order=sensor_order, ax=ax5)
ax5.set_xlabel('Sensor Type')
ax5.set_ylabel('Price (USD)')
ax5.set_title('Price Distribution by Sensor Type')
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 6. Pie chart: Distribution by sensor type
ax6 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 6)
sensor_counts = df['sensor_type'].value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax6.pie(sensor_counts.values, labels=sensor_counts.index, 
                                   autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90)
ax6.set_title('Distribution by Sensor Type')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 7. Heatmap: Correlation matrix
ax7 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 7)
numeric_cols = ['model_year', 'megapixels', 'max_iso', 'weight_grams', 'price_usd']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, square=True, ax=ax7, cbar_kws={'label': 'Correlation'})
ax7.set_title('Feature Correlation Matrix')

# 8. Stacked bar: Features by brand
ax8 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 8)
brand_features = df.pivot_table(index='brand', 
                                values=['megapixels', 'max_iso', 'weight_grams'],
                                aggfunc='mean')
brand_features_norm = brand_features.div(brand_features.max(axis=0), axis=1)
x = np.arange(len(brand_features_norm))
width = 0.25

bars1 = ax8.bar(x - width, brand_features_norm['megapixels'], width, label='Megapixels')
bars2 = ax8.bar(x, brand_features_norm['max_iso'], width, label='Max ISO')
bars3 = ax8.bar(x + width, brand_features_norm['weight_grams'], width, label='Weight')

ax8.set_xlabel('Brand')
ax8.set_ylabel('Normalized Value')
ax8.set_title('Normalized Features by Brand')
ax8.set_xticks(x)
ax8.set_xticklabels(brand_features_norm.index)
ax8.legend()
ax8.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 9. Radar chart for one camera (Leica 2016 as example)
ax9 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 9, projection='polar')
camera = df.iloc[4]  # Leica 2016
categories = ['Megapixels', 'Max ISO', 'Weight', 'Price', 'Year']
values = [
    camera['megapixels'] / df['megapixels'].max(),
    camera['max_iso'] / df['max_iso'].max(),
    1 - (camera['weight_grams'] / df['weight_grams'].max()),  # Inverted (lighter is better)
    camera['price_usd'] / df['price_usd'].max(),
    (camera['model_year'] - df['model_year'].min()) / (df['model_year'].max() - df['model_year'].min())
]

N = len(categories)
angles = [n / float(N) * 2 * np.pi for n in range(N)]
angles += angles[:1]
values += values[:1]

ax9.plot(angles, values, 'o-', linewidth=2)
ax9.fill(angles, values, alpha=0.25)
ax9.set_xticks(angles[:-1])
ax9.set_xticklabels(categories)
ax9.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax9.set_title(f'{camera["brand"]} {camera["model_year"]}\nFeature Radar Chart', y=1.1)

plt.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, b
